observations: Photo 0 shows a large, dirty engine being loaded into a shipping container using a crane.
Photo 1 shows a side view of the engine with a yellow and grey valve cover, red oil filters, and a blue alternator.
Photo 2 shows the front of the engine with a large flywheel, red oil filler cap, and a black alternator.
The engine has visible rust, grime, and wear, especially on the cylinder head, oil pan, and flywheel.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Cat 3208 Engine' and 'complete' for marine use.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number on the engine in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
The engine appears to be in a container with a crane, suggesting it is being loaded, but no proof of completeness (e.g., all components, no missing parts) is visible.
The engine's appearance (rust, grime, size) suggests it may be used, but its suitability for marine use cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: Engine may not be a Cat 3208 as claimed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used marine engine, not a specific Cat 3208, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing parts
risks.proof: A full inventory photo showing all components (cylinders, crankshaft, alternator, etc.) and a list of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to check for damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts-only.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand and model number.
Photo or video showing the engine running or a close-up of internal components.
Full inventory photo showing all included parts.
Proof of marine compatibility (e.g., certification, documentation).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
